sources.document_title: Manual on Artificial Recharge of Ground Water
sources.notes: Primary source for Table 7.2 roof runoff coefficients, the rooftop water-availability equation, and the dependence of storage sizing on demand/event rainfall and rainfall distribution.

sources.document_title: Guide on Artificial Recharge to Ground Water
sources.notes: Planning, investigation and design context. No universal residential threshold is encoded from this source without an exact applicable clause.

sources.authority: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), State Unit Office New Delhi
sources.document_title: Standard Designs for Adoption of Roof Top Rainwater Harvesting in Delhi
sources.section: Technical design A and B; applicability notes and drawings
sources.notes: Location-specific CGWB standard designs. Encoded only for NCT Delhi: trench without recharge well for alluvial formation, groundwater >5 m and <=15 m bgl, and no basement; trench with recharge well for alluvial/hard-rock formation and groundwater >15 m bgl. Published roof-area tables cover up to 500 m2. The document states designs are indicative and depend on site conditions.

sources.document_title: Frequently Asked Questions on Artificial Recharge and Rainwater Harvesting
sources.notes: States artificial recharge structures are not recommended where post-monsoon groundwater levels are shallower than 3 m bgl and identifies contamination-prevention and field/site design considerations.

sources.document_title: Master Plan for Artificial Recharge to Groundwater in India
sources.notes: Macro planning source based on hydrogeology, water-level trends, subsurface storage and surplus runoff. State-specific planning assumptions are not universal household design rules.

sources.document_title: Ground Water Resource Estimation Committee Methodology (GEC-2015)
sources.notes: Assessment-unit groundwater-resource methodology; not used for household recharge-structure sizing.

sources.document_title: National Aquifer Mapping and Management Programme
sources.document_version_or_year: Programme information current at access date
sources.notes: Official source family for aquifer geometry, properties, groundwater behaviour, availability and quality. Individual imported features must identify their report and resolution.

sources.document_title: All India Districtwise Rainfall Normals (1971-2020) Annual
sources.document_version_or_year: 1971-2020 rainfall normal; published for use from southwest monsoon 2022
sources.section: Annual district rainfall-normal map and Rainfallinmm_1.js feature layer
sources.notes: Official district-polygon annual rainfall normals. IMD's 14 April 2022 release states the normal is based on 50 years (1971-2020), replaces 1961-2010, and is updated once per decade. Used only for annual harvesting potential, not design-storm or tank reliability sizing.

sources.document_title: IMD Public API Reference
sources.notes: Documents current observed/daily rainfall products. These endpoints are not used as annual-normal data.

sources.document_title: All India Districtwise Rainfall Normals (1971-2020) — Monthly
sources.section: January through December district rainfall-normal maps and feature layers
sources.notes: Official twelve-month district-polygon normals. Each imported record preserves the URL and feature identifier for every month. Used for monthly storage sizing; annual rainfall is not divided by twelve.

sources.document_title: Updated Rainfall Normal based on data of 1971-2020
sources.notes: Documents the 50-year 1971-2020 normal, its once-per-decade update cycle, and replacement of the 1961-2010 normal.

sources.document_title: Nominatim Search API
sources.section: Free-form search, address details and countrycodes filter
sources.notes: Non-engineering, replaceable geocoding provider. It resolves user text to coordinates; it is not the rainfall authority. Provider ranking and candidate count are exposed rather than converted into an application confidence score.

sources.document_title: IS 15797:2008 Roof top rainwater harvesting — Guidelines
sources.notes: Status verified through the BIS WRD 3 Programme of Work. Detailed clauses are not encoded until the standard text is lawfully available to the project.

sources.authority: Indian Railways Institute of Civil Engineering (IRICEN)
sources.document_title: Rain Water Harvesting
sources.section: 2.2.8 and 2.2.8.1 — Storage tank and matching capacity with roof area
sources.notes: Primary government engineering source for the implemented monthly cumulative harvested-water versus monthly-demand storage method and July-to-June worked table. The application uses current CGWB coefficients rather than copying the example's coefficient.

sources.document_title: IS 15792:2008 Artificial recharge to ground water — Guidelines
sources.notes: Status verified through the BIS WRD 3 Programme of Work. Structure criteria and dimensions remain unsupported until the standard and amendment are reviewed.

sources.document_title: Bhuvan WMS services guidance and Water Sector information
sources.notes: Only documented OGC/download services may be integrated. Interactive pages are not scraped, and restricted groundwater-prospect attributes are not assumed available.

sources.document_title: November ground water level data 1994-2023 (2022 station records)
sources.notes: Official CGWB seasonal depth-to-water-level observations in metres below ground level. The bundled cache is a limited Bengaluru Urban subset and is stale; it is never presented as a property measurement.

sources.document_title: Ground Water Quality Data 2020
sources.notes: Official station table supplies the published latitude and longitude for station W125200077350001. Coordinates are rounded to two decimal places and are used only to estimate distance to the monitoring point.

sources.document_title: India-WRIS Groundwater Stations ArcGIS service
sources.document_version_or_year: Service metadata current at access date
sources.notes: Official station metadata service. It does not by itself establish a current depth measurement; water-level observations require a dated CGWB/India-WRIS record.

sources.document_title: India-WRIS Soil_1New ArcGIS service
sources.document_version_or_year: Service metadata current at access date
sources.notes: Official service metadata advertises map/query capability and GeoJSON support, but the soil sublayer schema/features were not reliably retrievable during implementation. No soil record is used until a documented feature/layer is exported and reviewed. Regional soil class must not be converted into a measured infiltration rate.

sources.authority: National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC) / Geological Survey of India (GSI)
sources.document_title: AquiferSystems_GSI ArcGIS Feature Service
sources.document_version_or_year: Service metadata current at access date
sources.section: Principal Aquifers and Major Aquifers layers
sources.notes: Official polygon service advertises aquifer/lithology-related fields. No value is used until a reviewed feature intersecting the property coordinate is imported.
